animations.name: swipe-out
animations.css: @keyframes swipe-out { 0% { transform: translateY(calc(var(--lift) * var(--offset) + var(--swipe-amount))); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(calc(var(--lift) * var(--offset) + var(--swipe-amount) + var(--lift) * -100%)); opacity: 0; } }
animations.description: Toast swipe-out animation for dismissing notifications.

animations.name: sonner-fade-in
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
animations.description: Toast fade-in animation with scale effect for notification appearance.

animations.name: sonner-fade-out
animations.css: @keyframes sonner-fade-out { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } }
animations.description: Toast fade-out animation with scale effect for notification dismissal.

animations.name: sonner-spin

animations.name: button-transition
animations.css: transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), scale 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
animations.description: Global button transition with custom easing for interactive states.

insights: Supabase uses a sophisticated button system with 'raised-control-surface' and 'primary-solid' semantic tokens, enabling consistent theming across light/dark modes while maintaining visual hierarchy.

The design system heavily leverages CSS custom properties (variables) for colors, enabling seamless theme switching and component reusability. The cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) easing curve is used consistently across interactive elements for a smooth, premium feel.

Multiple marquee/scroll animations are used for visual interest in product cards (Storage file icons, Data APIs lines), but they pause by default and only run on hover to reduce visual noise and respect user attention.
